lines.zh: 我提着武器，沿着海岸走。
lines.en: I walk the coast with a weapon in hand.

lines.zh: 我弓着背，一步步摸过去。
lines.en: Hunched over, I feel my way along.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边看两边的草。
lines.en: I walk while checking the grass on both sides.

lines.zh: 我的靴子踩碎了一层贝壳。
lines.en: My boots crunch through shells.

lines.zh: 我朝你的方向慢跑过来。
lines.en: I jog toward you.

lines.zh: 我走过平原，腰上挂着弩。
lines.en: I cross the plain with a crossbow at my hip.
I skirt the water, unwilling to wet my feet.

lines.zh: 我走几步就停下来张望。
lines.en: Every few steps I stop and look.
I keep to the edge of the sand.
One of my ears keeps swivelling.

lines.zh: 我把武器换到另一只手。
lines.en: I swap my weapon to the other hand.
I close in step by step without a shout.
I go round the base of the rock.

lines.zh: 我朝你那边加快了脚步。
lines.en: I quicken my pace toward you.

lines.zh: 我弯腰穿过低矮的灌木。
lines.en: I duck through the low brush.

lines.zh: 我停下来，摸了摸腰间的袋子。
lines.en: I stop and touch the pouch at my hip.
I crouch with my weapon across my knees.
I am sharpening a blade, a thin sound.
I test the crossbow string.
I am looking out at the sea.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子很尖，一直在抽。
lines.en: My nose is sharp and keeps twitching.

lines.zh: 我把沙子从鞋里倒出来。
lines.en: I tip sand out of my shoe.
I am counting footprints on the ground.
I lean on a rock and rest.
I tighten my belt another notch.
I wait for you to swing the first blow.

lines.zh: 我把手指伸进沙里搅了搅。
lines.en: I stir my fingers in the sand.
I am watching smoke in the distance.
I push my sleeve up.

lines.zh: 我在数今天捡了几样东西。
lines.en: I count what I have picked up today.

lines.zh: 你身上有值钱的东西吗？
lines.en: Anything valuable on you?
I have seen your sort.
Stop and put your hands up.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，牙露了出来。
lines.en: I look up at you, teeth showing.
This beach belongs to us.

lines.zh: 侦察兵看鞋，也看你的刀。
lines.en: A scout eyes your boots — and your blade.
Do not size me up; it unsettles me.
Do not expect any courtesy.

lines.zh: 我在想你身上能拿什么。
lines.en: I am wondering what I can take from you.

lines.zh: 你把武器放下，我们谈谈。
lines.en: Put your weapon down and we can talk.
I curse and back off.
I press the wound and grit my teeth.

lines.zh: 这一下打得我乱了拍子。
lines.en: That threw off my timing.
I crouch low to recover.
I spit out sand.
A crack opens in my armour.
I grunt, putting on a brave face.
I duck behind the reef rock to catch my breath.
A fair cut, not a hard enough one.
I grip my weapon and reset my stance.
That thing in your hand; give it to me.
That at your waist looks good.
Set your pack down.
If you have coin, I may let you go.
Take a step back and I will have a look.
I want that shiny thing.

lines.zh: 你把东西扔过来，别走近。
lines.en: Toss it over; do not come closer.
Your pocket bulges.
Iron interests me more.
Leave the carrot and go.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我抓紧了武器。
lines.en: You bump me and I grip my weapon.
One shoulder shove and you stagger.
We collide and sand flies.
I am knocked back two steps.
I raise an arm to block, quickly.
You hit my shoulder and your hand numbs.
I grimace and do not give ground.

lines.zh: 分开之后，我立刻拉开距离。
lines.en: After we part, I open the distance at once.

lines.zh: 我踩到你的脚，故意踩的。
lines.en: I step on your foot, and on purpose.

lines.zh: 我被你推得脚尖转了向。
lines.en: You shove me and my toes turn.
We do not do such things.
I am busy finding food.

lines.zh: 你先把手里的东西给我。
lines.en: First give me what you are holding.
That depends on the tribe.
I snort.
That came from nowhere.
I look toward the sand.
I will not take that up.
I slide the blade back to my hip.
Ask elsewhere.
I snatch it and stuff it in my pouch.
I bend to pick it up, eyes still on you.
I take everything that hits the ground.
This iron has weight; it will trade well.
This will trade for a few iron pieces.
My tooth chips; it really is iron.
I slip it into my sleeve.
I take two and leave one.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿换不了几块肉
lines.en: This thing will not fetch even a few cuts of meat.
This pouch is too full.
My crossbow is already on you.
This target is mine.
I raise my weapon at you.
Stand still and raise your hands.
I level the crossbow.
Your position is caught in my eye.
His things are mine.

lines.zh: 我往前迈了一步，弩抬着。
lines.en: I step forward with the crossbow up.
I am locked on and will not switch.
Nobody else around; convenient.
I hang a few paces off your back.

lines.zh: 你往左边绕，我也斜过去。
lines.en: You swing left, and I angle across.
I raise the crossbow at your back.

lines.zh: 我踩着礁石从侧面截你
lines.en: I hop the reef rocks to cut you off.
I stay on your outside.
I can count your steps.
I do not shout; that would spoil it.
I bring the gap to ten paces.
You look back and I am already crouched.
I keep shifting your way.
My blade opens your arm.
My crossbow butt hits your shoulder.
A dirty blow, but it works.

lines.zh: 我撞在你胸口，然后退开。
lines.en: I slam your chest and pull away.
I kick the back of your knee.
You blocked the blade, not the elbow.
That one came from the waist.
I strike your hand and the weapon slips.
I slip in one more cut.
Not brutal; a warning.
I rise from behind a dune.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘后探出半个头
lines.en: Half my head rises from behind the dune.
I throw a stone first to test.
I crouch on the rock watching you.
I run over from the far coast.

lines.zh: 我落地，武器已经拿在手里。
lines.en: I land with my weapon already drawn.
I whistle.
I wade over from the shallows.

lines.zh: 我把头从灌木里探出来。
lines.en: I poke my head out of the bush.
This stretch belongs to us today.

lines.zh: 袖子着了，我拍了两把沙。
lines.en: My sleeve catches and I throw sand on it.

lines.zh: 我从礁石上滑下，摔进沙里。
lines.en: I slip off the rock and land in the sand.

lines.zh: 海水灌进嘴，我扑腾着往岸上。
lines.en: Seawater fills my mouth and I thrash for shore.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀翻，武器飞了。
lines.en: The blast flips me and my weapon flies.

lines.zh: 箭射穿我的肩膀，我咬牙拔了。
lines.en: An arrow through my shoulder; I pull it out through my teeth.
Magic hits and my sight blurs.

lines.zh: 饿了两天，我连弓都拉不开。
lines.en: Two days hungry, and I cannot draw the bow.
Lightning strikes and I flatten into the sand.

lines.zh: 虚空拽我，我抓着地上的草。
lines.en: The void pulls and I grab at the grass.
